signs.aries: You confront what frightens you head-on, and crises in your life arrive suddenly and are met with action rather than reflection.
signs.taurus: You hold on tightly to shared resources, change costs you more than most, and your transformations are slow, physical and permanent.
signs.gemini: You talk your way through what other people cannot name, and you are curious about death, money and secrets rather than afraid of them.
signs.cancer: Intimacy and safety are the same thing for you, inheritance and family money are entangled, and old hurts take a long time to release.
signs.leo: You want to be fully seen by the people closest to you, and your crises are dramatic, public and ultimately clarifying.
signs.virgo: You handle shared money meticulously, approach intimacy as something to get right, and analyse a crisis while you are still in it.
signs.libra: Joint finances and shared decisions are where your relationships are really tested, and you avoid the hard conversation until it forces itself.
signs.scorpio: Shared money and shared secrets are held very close here, and the crises of your life go all the way down to the foundations.
signs.sagittarius: You meet loss by looking for meaning in it, are frank about the things people avoid, and come out of crises larger rather than smaller.
signs.capricorn: You manage shared resources responsibly and unsentimentally, and you get through crisis by taking control of what can be controlled.
signs.aquarius: You are detached about the things people find most frightening, and your relationship to shared money and to intimacy is on your own terms.
signs.pisces: You feel other people's crises as though they were happening to you, and you are vague about joint money in a way that eventually costs you.
